stories.label: Iran war Day 5: US submarine sinks warship off Sri Lanka, Spain defies Trump, 1,000+ dead
stories.summary: Day 5: US submarine torpedoed Iranian frigate Iris Dena off Sri Lanka — 87 dead, 61 missing. First attack outside Middle East. Hegseth: 'Iranian navy rests at the bottom of the Persian Gulf.' 1,000+ civilians killed. IRGC taking wartime lead. Spain's Sánchez calls war 'Russian roulette with millions of lives,' defies Trump trade threats. EU backs Spain. NATO intercepted Iranian missile over Turkey. Golestan Palace (UNESCO) damaged. Iran intelligence signalling openness to CIA talks.

stories.label: Hormuz Day 5: Pakistan declares fuel emergency, global south shockwave
stories.summary: Hormuz shutdown Day 5. Pakistan declares emergency: ship insurance $30K→$400K, freight $900K→$4M, diesel price gap Rs 45-50/liter in first week. Weekly price revisions, mandatory WFH. Requesting Saudi oil via Red Sea/Yanbu. Tanzania fuel up 10.76%. Myanmar rationing fuel. Trump pledges navy escorts for oil tankers. Fitch reportedly cuts Indonesia rating outlook.

stories.label: Lebanon: All south of Litani ordered evacuated, Hezbollah drone swarms hit Tel Aviv
stories.summary: IDF ordered ALL residents south of Litani River to evacuate north 'urgently.' Any southward movement 'would endanger their lives.' Israeli forces entered villages near the border. Hezbollah launched drone swarms at military base near Tel Aviv and naval base in Haifa. Largest forced displacement since 2006.

stories.label: US Congress moves on war powers after senators fear 'boots on the ground'
stories.summary: Senate war powers resolution by Tim Kaine invokes 1973 WPR. Senate likely to reject bid to curb Trump's war powers. Armed Kurdish forces weigh ground offensive with US arms.

stories.label: Nepal votes March 5 — first election since Gen Z protests toppled government
stories.summary: Election tomorrow March 5. Watch for results.

stories.label: Khamenei succession: Mojtaba Khamenei frontrunner, funeral delayed over crowd concerns
stories.summary: Funeral delayed over crowd concerns. Mojtaba Khamenei frontrunner. Assembly of Experts building in Qom was bombed. IRGC has taken wartime lead ensuring harder line.

stories.label: Pakistan: Karachi shootings, visa suspension, nationwide protests
stories.summary: US Marines fired on Pakistani protesters at Karachi consulate. At least 10 killed. Visas suspended. JI announces nationwide protests. US orders non-emergency staff to leave Karachi, Lahore.

stories.label: Gaza sealed: crossings closed, aid halted — 6 cycles uncovered
stories.summary: Total siege continues. SIX cycles without dedicated coverage. Iran war providing total cover. Crossings sealed, aid halted. Newsom called Israel 'sort of an apartheid state.' The silence compounds.

stories.label: Sudan: War grinds on while world watches Iran
stories.summary: War continues with zero global diplomatic attention. UK banning student visas for Sudan nationals.

stories.label: Russian strikes at 3-year peak — Putin filling police with war veterans
stories.summary: 288 missiles in February — 3-year high. Putin calls for Ukraine war veterans to fill police staffing shortages. Moscow city laying off 15% of workforce amid budget strain. Iran war calls in Russia to abandon Ukraine talks.

stories.label: 1.1 million Filipino overseas workers at risk across 5 Middle East countries
stories.summary: 1.1M Filipino OFWs — mostly women in domestic work — trapped across five war-affected countries. Philippines also arresting nationals suspected of spying for China.

stories.label: British lawyers to sue UAE and RSF leaders in UK courts for Sudan war crimes
stories.summary: UK lawyers will file lawsuits in British courts against UAE and RSF leaders for war crimes.

stories.label: Chile's Kast halts transition over Chinese subsea cable intelligence
stories.summary: Far-right president-elect Kast suspended handover over Chinese subsea cable project.

stories.label: CBP used ad-tech data to track phones without warrants
stories.summary: Internal DHS document confirms CBP used ad ecosystem location data to track phones without warrants.

stories.label: Sun's 'glitches' during quiet periods explained by scientists
stories.summary: Scientists used helioseismology to explain anomalous vibrations in the Sun during phases of low activity.

stories.label: Lenovo ThinkPads score perfect 10/10 repairability from iFixit
stories.summary: First major laptop line to score 10/10 from iFixit. EU right-to-repair directive driving compliance.

stories.label: Motorola partners with GrapheneOS — bootloader unlockable/relockable
stories.summary: First mainstream manufacturer shipping privacy-focused OS.

stories.label: EU strips AI, chips, quantum from industrial plan countering China
stories.summary: EU's 'made in Europe' tech policy gutted. New 'Made in EU' proposals put forward to boost manufacturing.

stories.label: Quantum effects found functional in biological proteins
stories.summary: Evidence growing that quantum tunnelling and coherence play functional roles in proteins.

stories.label: Indonesia targets first nuclear power plant by 2032-2034
stories.summary: World's 4th most populous country commits to nuclear energy. Fitch reportedly cut rating outlook.

stories.label: FBI using AI as 'game changer' for hacking operations
stories.summary: FBI official called AI a 'game changer' for remote access operations.

stories.label: US government iPhone-hacking toolkit leaked to foreign spies
stories.summary: Coruna toolkit built for US government iPhone exploitation has reached foreign intelligence services.

stories.label: Nestlé sells baby cereal with 15% sugar in Africa, zero in Europe
stories.summary: Public Eye investigation: Nestlé's Cerelac baby cereal contains up to 15% added sugar in Africa, zero in Europe. Same brand, different standard. WHO recommends zero added sugar for children under 2.

stories.label: China sustains hours-long laser link with satellite 40,000km up
stories.summary: Chinese Academy of Sciences sustained high-speed laser communication with geostationary satellite (40,000km) for hours using 1.8m ground telescope. Critical for deep-space networks.

stories.label: AI translations injecting fabricated information into Wikipedia
stories.summary: AI-translated Wikipedia articles swapping sources, adding unsourced sentences, inserting paragraphs from unrelated material. Knowledge corruption at scale.

stories.label: AI avatar 'Gaitana' running to represent Indigenous voters in Colombia
stories.summary: Digital AI avatar 'Gaitana' is the public stand-in for two real Indigenous candidates, used to seek consensus from communities on all legislative matters. Named after 16th-century resistance leader.

stories.label: PM Abiy warns Eritrea: next attempt to harm Ethiopia 'will be the last'
stories.summary: PM Abiy warned Eritrea any further attempt to destabilize Ethiopia 'will be the last.' Ethiopia-Kenya agreed joint military operations for border corridor. Not yet covered but worth watching.

stories.label: Milei's legislative blitz: labour reform, criminal age lowered, glacier law weakened
stories.summary: Labour reform passed, criminal age lowered to 14, glacier protections weakened.

stories.label: Lockheed, defence contractors removing Anthropic AI after Trump ban
stories.summary: Defence contractors like Lockheed seen removing Anthropic AI after Trump ban. AI confirmed used in Iran strikes.

stories.label: France expands nuclear arsenal, deploys carrier to Mediterranean
stories.summary: France expanding nuclear arsenal. First repatriation flights landing from Middle East.

stories.label: Russia to block Telegram in April — 100M+ users affected
stories.summary: Kremlin says decision is 'final.' Last major channel for anti-war organizing.

stories.label: US opens chip door for Vietnam, locks it on China
stories.summary: Washington lifts export controls on Vietnam. Strategic chip supply chain shift.

stories.label: Mass graves in eastern DRC — US sanctions Rwanda's military
stories.summary: US sanctioned Rwanda's army chief. Mass graves near Uvira.

stories.label: Earth's oldest crystals suggest plate tectonics started 4.4 billion years ago
stories.summary: 4.4-billion-year-old zircon crystals suggest plate tectonics began far earlier than accepted.

stories.label: Meta smart glasses workers can see everything wearers see
stories.summary: Workers processing Meta smart glasses data can see everything wearers see.
